notes.title: Try them all!1.0.4
notes.content:
Try them all and open them! The 1.0.4 update of "Try It All and Open It!

Changes regarding skills: 
When a skill is purchased (opened), the skill is changed to be activated at the same time.
This function can be disabled from the checkbox in the upper right corner of the skill screen.
If a skill cannot be activated at the same time due to a condition, it will not be activated automatically.

Fixing gemstone colors 
Fixed a bug in which gemstones other than emeralds were not colored.

Fixes related to achievements 
The description of achievements stated that achievements with a smaller number of digits than the clear digits could be earned. 
However, in actual operation, achievements with a smaller number of digits than the clear digits were not being earned.
However, in actual operation, achievements with a smaller number of digits than the number of cleared digits were not being earned.

Fixes for full screen mode: 
Fixed a bug where the UI hit detection would shift when changing from window mode to full screen mode.


I would be very happy if you all could write a review.
